content:
आवेदन करने की अंतिम तिथि नजदीक है ✅

Railway RRB Technician Online Form 2026

  • Start Date : 30 June 2026
  • Last Date : 29 July 2026
  • Total : 6557 Posts
  • Eligibility : 10th Pass

Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs) have released CEN 02/2026 for Technician Grade-I (Signal) and Technician Grade-III – total 6,557 posts.

जिन अभ्यर्थियों ने अभी तक फॉर्म नहीं भरा – अंतिम तिथि नजदीक है। 29 July 2026 से पहले Submit कर लें।

Important Dates

  • Application Begin : 30 June 2026
  • Last Date for Apply Online : 29 July 2026
  • Exam Date (CBT) : As per RRB schedule
  • Admit Card : Before CBT

Eligibility

10th Pass candidates with prescribed ITI / trade qualification can apply for most Grade-III posts. Always read official CEN 02/2026 before applying.

Selection Process

CBT → Document Verification → Medical Examination.

How to Apply

  1. Open https://www.rrbapply.gov.in
  2. Click CEN 02/2026 Technician Apply Online
  3. Register, fill form, upload documents, pay fee
  4. Submit before 29 July 2026
  5. Keep application printout safe

Apply only on official RRB portal rrbapply.gov.in.
